BUG-01.title: Privacy Page Modification
BUG-01.description: Merchant App Privacy Policy copy must be audited and updated against actual codebase behavior (immediate account deletion with zero grace period, notification/audit log masking, and Cashfree/WhatsApp data processing).
BUG-01.verification_criteria: Privacy page renders accurate immediate-deletion, log masking, and Cashfree/WhatsApp processing details.
BUG-01.empirical_evidence: Privacy copy updated with DPDPA §12 zero grace period immediate anonymization, Cashfree Payments & EasySplit PCI-DSS Level 1 gateway, WhatsApp Cloud API notifications, and field-level telemetry masking. Verified by automated test.

BUG-02.title: Immediate Account Deletion — Zero Postponement
BUG-02.description: Remove any postponement, grace-period timer, or delayed deletion queue in merchant/staff account deletion. Execution must be immediate upon user confirmation (atomic PII deletion/anonymization, session revoke, auth user deletion, immediate redirect/sign out with accurate message).
BUG-02.verification_criteria: Account deletion executes immediately with zero delayed queue/postponement and revokes auth session.
BUG-02.empirical_evidence: Database RPC delete_account_immediately invoked immediately; profiles.full_name scrubbed to 'Deleted User', phone to NULL, push token scrubbed, and session revoked via supabase.auth.signOut(). Tested and verified with 200 OK and scheduled_for=null.

BUG-03.title: Doctors Not Showing in Team Filter — Master Hospital Staff
BUG-03.description: Fix role enum/casing mismatch ('doctor' vs 'consultant' vs 'DOCTOR'), join condition, or query filter so doctors appear properly when filtering by Doctors on the Team / Master Hospital Staff screen.
BUG-03.verification_criteria: Filtering by Doctors in Team / Master Hospital Staff displays all active doctor/consultant accounts.
BUG-03.empirical_evidence: loadTeam now queries both merchant_memberships and department_members with departments(name); allRosterMembers merges resource doctors ensuring membershipRole='doctor'; StaffRosterTable checks doctor and consultant roles properly.

BUG-04_05.title: Strictly One hospitalAdmin per Hospital + Remove from Provision Staff + Fix False Success Toast
BUG-04_05.description: Enforce at most one active hospitalAdmin per hospital with a PostgreSQL partial unique index and backend validation (409 Conflict). Remove hospitalAdmin from Provision Staff assignable role options when an admin already exists. Ensure UI never fires false-positive success toasts on mutation failure.
BUG-04_05.verification_criteria: DB partial unique index blocks duplicate hospitalAdmin; UI removes hospitalAdmin option when present; UI toast only fires on true 2xx success.
BUG-04_05.empirical_evidence: PostgreSQL index idx_merchant_memberships_single_hospital_admin blocks duplicates (PostgreSQL error 23505); API returns HTTP 409 Conflict; UnifiedAddStaffModal hides Hospital Admin role tab when hasHospitalAdmin is true; UI throws and prevents success toast on error.

BUG-06.title: 'Assign to Department' Broken in Consultant/Doctor & Frontdesk Flows
BUG-06.description: Fix department assignment dropping/failure across form state, API payloads, DB persistence, and staff roster view for both Consultant/Doctor and Frontdesk staff.
BUG-06.verification_criteria: Adding/editing Consultant or Frontdesk with a department persists department_id to DB and renders correctly on reload.
BUG-06.empirical_evidence: Added department_id column to public.resources; UnifiedAddStaffModal passes selectedDeptId to resources and department_members; POST /api/admin/doctor-assignments persists front desk department assignments into department_members; department displays on staff roster rows.
